body.intent: Let the web UI listen on all interfaces so a Caddy reverse proxy on another host can reach it. Owner, verbatim: "in order to proxy the web ui via caddy we need to bind to all hosts and not just local host." This supersedes the localhost part of decision web-ui-in-daemon-read-only. Add a rhiza.web.host setting (default 127.0.0.1; 0.0.0.0 binds all interfaces) beside rhiza.web.port, settable with rhiza daemon set and followed live like the port; daemon status shows the bound address. The UI stays read-only.
